brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: 4 pieces in row: piece:0,0,0;full through piece:3,0,0;full

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: run:run-1 entry 3 through 1,0,0 -> 2,0,0 -> 3,0,0 passes through all 4 bases; bases contain pipe hardware, bins are third-depth drain variants that fit over pipe

finish.summary: Built 4-cell linear planter (0,0 to 3,0) with a continuous water pipe run through all bases. Each cell fitted with third-depth drained planter bins, filled with soil and planted, demonstrating feed to every cell. Pipe laid before bins per house rule (pipe-through cells only accept third-depth bins).

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
